entries.title: Hebrews 8:1
segments: Throne of the Majesty in the heavens. An expression equivalent to 'at the right hand of God.'  'In the heavens' is 'in the highest places.' See

entries.title: Hebrews 8:2
segments: True tabernacle. The original, ideal, spiritual tabernacle, of which the tabernacle of the Old Testament was but a type, a symbol, or a shadow.  God prepared the Hebrew mind for the conception of a spiritual household by a material symbol thereof.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:6
segments: Better covenant. A covenant of universal forgiveness for mankind, and written in the human heart, as contrasted with a covenant of strict obedience embodied in commandments written on tables of stone.  Under the new covenant, love to God as revealed in Christ, gives life to Christian service.  The letter of the old law led to dead formalism.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:11
segments: They shall not teach every man. The old covenant was national; the new shall be individual.  Every man shall have the new life in his heart by faith in Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:12
segments: I will be merciful, etc.  A gracious and free forgiveness of sins, even the blotting out of the remembrance of them.  See

entries.title: Hebrews 8:13
segments: A new covenant. The prophet saw in vision a better day, with the old legal covenant superseded, and the new covenant of God's grace begun.
